es.summary: Hormona sintética que estimula las contracciones uterinas; se usa para inducir o conducir el trabajo de parto y para prevenir y tratar la hemorragia posparto.
key_points: Medicamento de alto riesgo: siempre en bomba de infusión, conectado como línea secundaria.
Vigilar la taquisistolia: más de 5 contracciones en 10 minutos (promedio de 30 minutos).
Ante taquisistolia o FCF alterada: suspender la oxitocina, decúbito lateral, bolo de líquidos IV y avisar.
Tiene efecto antidiurético: con uso prolongado puede causar intoxicación hídrica (hiponatremia).
Después del alumbramiento ayuda a contraer el útero y prevenir la hemorragia posparto.

mechanism: Se une a receptores del miometrio y aumenta la frecuencia y la fuerza de las contracciones.
La sensibilidad del útero a la oxitocina aumenta al final del embarazo.
Tiene un efecto antidiurético parecido a la hormona antidiurética.
indications: Inducción del trabajo de parto por indicación médica.
Conducción del trabajo de parto con contracciones insuficientes.
Manejo activo del tercer periodo y prevención de la hemorragia posparto.
contraindications: Desproporción cefalopélvica o presentación fetal anómala.
Estado fetal no tranquilizador que requiere nacimiento urgente.
Cualquier situación en la que esté contraindicado el parto vaginal.
adverse_effects: Alteraciones de la FCF por menor oxigenación fetal.
Intoxicación hídrica: cefalea, náuseas, confusión y convulsiones por hiponatremia.
Hipotensión y taquicardia si se administra en bolo IV rápido.
interactions: Otros uterotónicos o prostaglandinas (misoprostol): mayor riesgo de taquisistolia; respetar los intervalos del protocolo.
nursing_care: Verificar indicación, bienestar fetal basal y presentación antes de iniciar.
Preparar con la dilución institucional y administrar con bomba como línea secundaria lo más cerca del sitio de punción.
Titular según protocolo y orden médica; doble verificación de la velocidad.
Monitoreo continuo de la FCF y la actividad uterina (frecuencia, duración, intensidad y tono en reposo).
Ante taquisistolia o FCF alterada: suspender, decúbito lateral, bolo de líquidos IV, oxígeno según protocolo y avisar.
Control de ingesta y excreta; vigilar signos de intoxicación hídrica.
patient_teaching: Explicar que las contracciones pueden volverse más fuertes y frecuentes.
Avisar si siente una contracción que no se relaja, dolor intenso continuo o sangrado.
Comentar opciones para el manejo del dolor durante la inducción.
antidote_overdose: No tiene antídoto específico; su vida media es de pocos minutos, así que se suspende la infusión.
Para taquisistolia persistente puede indicarse un tocolítico (p. ej., terbutalina) según protocolo.

care_plans.diagnosis: Riesgo de alteración de la díada materno-fetal
related_to: Menor oxigenación fetal durante contracciones frecuentes
outcomes: Estado fetal: intraparto — FCF entre 110 y 160 lpm con variabilidad moderada.
Estado materno: intraparto — contracciones adecuadas sin taquisistolia.

interventions.action: Vigilar continuamente la FCF y la actividad uterina durante la infusión.
interventions.rationale: Detecta a tiempo la taquisistolia y el compromiso fetal.

interventions.action: Titular la oxitocina según protocolo y documentar cada cambio.
Ante taquisistolia o FCF alterada, suspender la infusión, colocar en decúbito lateral y avisar.
interventions.rationale: Restaura el flujo útero-placentario y la oxigenación fetal.

interventions.action: Administrar bolo de líquidos IV y oxígeno según protocolo.
interventions.rationale: Mejora la perfusión materna y fetal.

interventions.action: Valorar el tono uterino en reposo entre contracciones.
interventions.rationale: Un útero que no se relaja reduce el oxígeno al feto.

en.summary: Synthetic hormone that stimulates uterine contractions; used to induce or augment labor and to prevent and treat postpartum hemorrhage.
key_points: High-alert medication: always by infusion pump, piggybacked as a secondary line.
Watch for tachysystole: more than 5 contractions in 10 minutes (averaged over 30 minutes).
For tachysystole or an abnormal FHR: stop oxytocin, side-lying position, IV fluid bolus and notify.
It has an antidiuretic effect: prolonged use can cause water intoxication (hyponatremia).
After the placenta delivers, it helps the uterus contract and prevents postpartum hemorrhage.

mechanism: Binds to myometrial receptors and increases the frequency and strength of contractions.
Uterine sensitivity to oxytocin increases at the end of pregnancy.
Has an antidiuretic effect similar to antidiuretic hormone.
indications: Augmentation of labor with inadequate contractions.
Active management of the third stage and prevention of postpartum hemorrhage.
contraindications: Cephalopelvic disproportion or abnormal fetal presentation.
Non-reassuring fetal status that requires urgent delivery.
Any situation where vaginal birth is contraindicated.
adverse_effects: FHR changes from reduced fetal oxygenation.
Water intoxication: headache, nausea, confusion and seizures from hyponatremia.
Hypotension and tachycardia with a rapid IV bolus.
interactions: Other uterotonics or prostaglandins (misoprostol): higher risk of tachysystole; follow protocol intervals.
nursing_care: Confirm the indication, baseline fetal well-being and presentation before starting.
Prepare with the facility's dilution and give by pump as a secondary line closest to the IV site.
Titrate per protocol and order; double-check the rate.
Continuous FHR and uterine activity monitoring (frequency, duration, intensity and resting tone).
For tachysystole or abnormal FHR: stop, side-lying, IV fluid bolus, oxygen per protocol and notify.
Intake and output; watch for signs of water intoxication.
patient_teaching: Explain that contractions may become stronger and more frequent.
Report a contraction that doesn't relax, constant severe pain or bleeding.
Discuss pain management options during induction.
antidote_overdose: No specific antidote; its half-life is a few minutes, so the infusion is stopped.
For persistent tachysystole a tocolytic (e.g., terbutaline) may be ordered per protocol.

related_to: Reduced fetal oxygenation with frequent contractions
outcomes: Fetal Status: Intrapartum — FHR 110–160 bpm with moderate variability.
Maternal Status: Intrapartum — adequate contractions without tachysystole.

interventions.action: Monitor FHR and uterine activity continuously during the infusion.
interventions.rationale: Detects tachysystole and fetal compromise early.

interventions.action: Titrate oxytocin per protocol and document every change.
For tachysystole or abnormal FHR, stop the infusion, turn the patient on her side and notify.
interventions.rationale: Restores uteroplacental blood flow and fetal oxygenation.

interventions.action: Give an IV fluid bolus and oxygen per protocol.
Assess resting uterine tone between contractions.
interventions.rationale: A uterus that doesn't relax reduces fetal oxygen.

summary.0.quote: Postpartum Oxytocin injection (synthetic) is indicated to produce uterine contractions during the third stage of labor and to control postpartum bleeding or hemorrhage.

key_points.3.quote: Oxytocin has been shown to have an intrinsic antidiuretic effect, acting to increase water reabsorption from the glomerular filtrate.

key_points.4.quote: Oxytocin can also be used as one of several medications for the treatment of postpartum hemorrhage.

sections.mechanism.0.quote: Oxytocin binds to receptors in the uterine muscle to stimulate contractions.

sections.mechanism.1.quote: It exerts a selective action on the smooth musculature of the uterus, particularly toward the end of pregnancy, during labor and immediately following delivery.

sections.mechanism.2.quote: Oxytocin has been shown to have an intrinsic antidiuretic effect, acting to increase water reabsorption from the glomerular filtrate.

sections.indications.0.quote: Oxytocin Injection, USP (synthetic) is indicated for the medical rather than the elective induction of labor.

sections.indications.1.quote: In these cases, labor augmentation with intravenous oxytocin is used.

sections.indications.2.quote: Postpartum Oxytocin injection (synthetic) is indicated to produce uterine contractions during the third stage of labor and to control postpartum bleeding or hemorrhage.

sections.indications.3.quote: To control postpartum bleeding, 10 to 40 units of oxytocin may be added to 1,000 mL of a nonhydrating diluent and run at a rate necessary to control uterine atony.

sections.contraindications.0.quote: Oxytocin injection (synthetic) is contraindicated in any of the following conditions: • Significant cephalopelvic disproportion; • Unfavorable fetal positions or presentations which are undeliverable without conversion prior to delivery,

sections.contraindications.2.quote: Contraindications placenta or vasa previa fetal malposition umbilical cord presentation prior classical uterine incision active genital herpes infection pelvic structure deformities invasive cervical cancer

sections.contraindications.3.quote: Contraindications placenta or vasa previa fetal malposition umbilical cord presentation prior classical uterine incision active genital herpes infection pelvic structure deformities invasive cervical cancer

sections.adverse_effects.0.quote: Hyperstimulation with strong (hypertonic) or prolonged (tetanic) contractions, or a resting tone of 15 to 20 mm H 2 O or more between contractions can lead to tumultuous labor, uterine rupture, cervical and vaginal lacerations, postpartum hemorrhage, uteroplacental hypoperfusion and variable deceleration of fetal heart, fetal hypoxia, hypercapnia or death.

sections.adverse_effects.2.quote: Hyperstimulation with strong (hypertonic) or prolonged (tetanic) contractions, or a resting tone of 15 to 20 mm H 2 O or more between contractions can lead to tumultuous labor, uterine rupture, cervical and vaginal lacerations, postpartum hemorrhage, uteroplacental hypoperfusion and variable deceleration of fetal heart, fetal hypoxia, hypercapnia or death.

sections.interactions.1.quote: Severe hypertension has been reported when oxytocin was given three to four hours following prophylactic administration of a vasoconstrictor in conjunction with caudal block anesthesia.

sections.nursing_care.3.quote: The fetal heart rate, resting uterine tone, and the frequency, duration, and force of contractions should be monitored.

sections.antidote_overdose.0.quote: When an oxytocin infusion is stopped, the amount of oxytocin in the plasma rapidly declines due to the drug’s 3- to 5-minute half-life (U.S. Food and Drug Administration (USFDA), n.d.).

sections.antidote_overdose.1.quote: The nurse caring for laboring persons will at times administer terbutaline to relax the uterus, as in cases of fetal bradycardia, tachysystole, Category III tracings, and preterm labor.
